tasks.final_text: I really enjoy dark chocoloate.  The brands that I prefer are Amano and Ritual.  Recently a Ritual bar that I purchased was less smooth than normal.  It felt/tasted almost like a nib bar.  I wonder if their conching process is off or if this was intended.  Amano is generally smooth.

The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka.  It is locatdd in the odlest remaining Dutch building the the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat for the Dutch garrison at the fort.
